== Biography ==
'''Thomas Glasgow''' was born on 12 Jan 1749 and baptised at Edinburgh, Midlothian, on 09 Feb 1749. The parish register names his father as [[Glasgow-3582|John Glasgow]] and records his mother as ‘Elizt Morison’.<ref name="FMP1" /> The mother’s profile identity remains unassessed. The previous draft linked the named mother to [[Morrison-24595|Eliz Morison]]; retain that as a superseded candidate mapping, not an established identity. The register records both dates; Edinburgh is inferred from the baptism and is not independently recorded.
